title: Data model
prompt: Team wants “Mongo because JSON” for a workload that is mostly relational joins on stable schemas with multi-row transactions. Pick the response.

choices.label: Model entities from queries; keep relational + transactions unless a force says otherwise
choices.consequence: Access path and consistency beat format fashion.

choices.label: Adopt Mongo for the vibe
choices.consequence: You inherit join/transaction pain without a force.

choices.label: Dual-write every row to both stores from day one
choices.consequence: Dual-write without a need doubles failure modes.

choices.label: Store everything in CSV on disk
